performance_scale.definition: Evidence is absent, materially incorrect, unsafe, or insufficient.
Partial performance; substantial guidance or correction is required.
Meets standard with reasonable guidance, templates, prompts, or intervention.
Meets standard reliably without substantive intervention.
Performs independently across complexity and can effectively guide or review others.

verified.note: Reviewer judgment is bounded by the rubric; Verified is not a simple arithmetic average.

rubrics.name: Self-Direction
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently manages a multi-step goal over time.
rubrics.applied_standard: Manages a real project or work objective with normal accountability.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Helps another participant plan, adapt, and recover from setbacks without taking over.

rubrics.name: Communication
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently communicates effectively in at least two formats.
rubrics.applied_standard: Communication is used successfully with a real stakeholder or audience.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews and improves another person's communication effectively and accurately.

rubrics.name: Collaboration
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently contributes to a team project with reliable follow-through.
rubrics.applied_standard: Works effectively on a real multidisciplinary or cross-role team.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Improves team function and coaches others without taking over their responsibilities.

rubrics.name: Research Literacy
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently evaluates and uses sources appropriately.
rubrics.applied_standard: Research literacy informs a real project decision or deliverable.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Detects weak reasoning in others' research and explains corrections accurately.

rubrics.name: Digital Fluency
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently completes a professional digital workflow without unsafe practices.
rubrics.applied_standard: Uses digital tools reliably in real project operations.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Helps others solve workflows without creating security, privacy, or data-management problems.

rubrics.name: Civic & Institutional Literacy
rubrics.verified_minimum: Correctly maps how a real issue moves through relevant institutions.
rubrics.applied_standard: Navigates a real institutional process appropriately.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Helps others choose the correct institution/process without overstating authority.

rubrics.name: Professional Practice
rubrics.verified_minimum: Shows sustained independent professional behavior across a meaningful project period.
rubrics.applied_standard: Performs reliably in authentic service or work.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Models professional standards and gives actionable feedback to others.

rubrics.name: Safety & Resilience
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently follows safe procedures in a realistic exercise.
rubrics.applied_standard: Responds appropriately in a real operational setting within assigned authority.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Guides others through exercises or readiness work without improvising beyond authorization.

rubrics.name: Project Management
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently manages a bounded project from plan through closeout.
rubrics.applied_standard: Delivers a real project with normal accountability.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Guides another project manager and identifies material risks early.

rubrics.name: Ethics, Consent & Privacy
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently makes correct judgments on realistic ethical/privacy scenarios.
rubrics.applied_standard: Operates a real workflow involving sensitive information without material violations.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews others' protocols accurately and identifies privacy/consent failures.

rubrics.name: Data Literacy
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently analyzes a dataset and communicates justified conclusions.
rubrics.applied_standard: Analysis informs an authentic decision or project.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Catches interpretation errors and teaches better analysis to others.

rubrics.name: Documentation & Provenance
rubrics.verified_minimum: Another reviewer can reconstruct the work from the documentation.
rubrics.applied_standard: Maintains audit-ready records during authentic work.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Designs or improves provenance practices for a team.

rubrics.name: Facilitation & Meetings
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently facilitates a real or realistic meeting to usable outcomes.
rubrics.applied_standard: Leads an authentic stakeholder or team meeting.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Handles difficult dynamics and coaches other facilitators.

rubrics.name: Accessible & Inclusive Practice
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently identifies and remedies common accessibility barriers.
rubrics.applied_standard: Ships an accessible real product, event, or communication.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Audits and improves others' work for accessibility and inclusion.

rubrics.name: Community Engagement
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently conducts respectful two-way engagement.
rubrics.applied_standard: Maintains or contributes to a sustained real community relationship.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Guides engagement strategy and prevents extractive practices.

rubrics.name: Service Navigation
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently routes a realistic case accurately.
rubrics.applied_standard: Helps a real participant navigate services appropriately.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Supervises navigators and maintains resource accuracy.

rubrics.name: Stakeholder Coordination
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently coordinates multiple parties around a shared objective.
rubrics.applied_standard: Coordinates authentic multi-organization work.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Manages complex relationship networks and coaches others.

rubrics.name: Public Program Delivery
strong_qualifying_evidence: IRS-VITA-BASIC-2025 / IRS-VITA-ADVANCED-2025 plus supervised service evidence
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently performs assigned program duties to standard.
rubrics.applied_standard: Delivers an actual public-facing service within the program's rules.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Supervises delivery and resolves routine quality problems appropriately.

rubrics.name: Emergency & Incident Coordination
strong_qualifying_evidence: FEMA-IS-100-C / FEMA-IS-200-C or other catalog-resolved FEMA training
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently performs an assigned role in a realistic incident exercise.
rubrics.applied_standard: Performs an authentic emergency/continuity role where available and appropriate.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Designs or runs exercises or coaches roles while preserving authorization boundaries.

rubrics.name: Research Design
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently designs a defensible study appropriate to the question.
rubrics.applied_standard: Protocol is used in a real research project.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews and improves others' research designs accurately.

rubrics.name: Source Evaluation
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently evaluates conflicting sources and explains relative evidentiary strength.
rubrics.applied_standard: Source judgments materially shape an authentic research product.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews source selections across complex projects and challenges weak evidence appropriately.

rubrics.name: Human Research Methods
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently performs competently after ethics prerequisites, with participant protection meeting the independent standard.
rubrics.applied_standard: Conducts authentic approved human-participant research.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Supervises data collection and reviews protocols within appropriate authority.

rubrics.name: Evidence Synthesis
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently builds defensible conclusions from multiple sources.
rubrics.applied_standard: Synthesis is used in an authentic report or decision process.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews complex evidence chains and identifies weak inference.

rubrics.name: Policy Analysis
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently compares alternatives using explicit evidence and assumptions.
rubrics.applied_standard: Analysis is delivered to a real stakeholder or institution.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Supervises policy analysis and detects framing bias or unsupported inference.

rubrics.name: Publication & Citation
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently prepares auditable work for publication or formal release.
rubrics.applied_standard: Completes an authentic publication or formal submission.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Performs editorial/reviewer functions and manages corrections responsibly.

rubrics.name: Opportunity Discovery
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently identifies and validates a genuine opportunity.
rubrics.applied_standard: Opportunity becomes a real project, application, service, or business path.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Critiques opportunity quality and evidence for others.

rubrics.name: User / Customer Discovery
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently conducts discovery and extracts defensible needs.
rubrics.applied_standard: Findings shape a real service, product, or project.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews discovery research and coaches others.

rubrics.name: Offer & Scope Design
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently produces a clear deliverable scope with manageable boundaries.
rubrics.applied_standard: Scope is accepted and used on real work.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews scope, protects against ambiguity, and coaches scope control.

rubrics.name: Financial & Operational Basics
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently builds and explains a realistic basic operating budget or model.
rubrics.applied_standard: Model is used in authentic project/program operations.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews models and identifies material omissions or unsupported assumptions.

rubrics.name: Client / Project Delivery
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently delivers bounded work that meets agreed acceptance criteria.
rubrics.applied_standard: Completes real client or partner delivery.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Supervises delivery teams and handles escalations appropriately.

rubrics.name: Workforce & Career Navigation
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently presents capability credibly and navigates an application process.
rubrics.applied_standard: Participates in an authentic apprenticeship, job, fellowship, or comparable opportunity process.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Coaches others using evidence-based guidance rather than generic advice.

rubrics.name: Story & Message Development
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently develops a coherent factual message for a defined audience.
rubrics.applied_standard: Message is used in a real publication, event, or campaign.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Edits others' story strategy without sacrificing factual integrity.

rubrics.name: Capture & Production
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently captures usable professional-quality source material.
rubrics.applied_standard: Completes authentic event, client, editorial, or project production.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Directs production and troubleshoots under real constraints.

rubrics.name: Editing & Post-Production
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently produces publication-ready media from raw material.
rubrics.applied_standard: Releases or delivers an authentic media product.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Supervises post-production and provides precise editorial guidance.

rubrics.name: Verification, Rights & Licensing
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently clears content correctly before publication.
rubrics.applied_standard: Manages rights for actual licensed or released work.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews complex rights issues and prevents unauthorized publication.

rubrics.name: Publication, Distribution & Audience

criteria.name: Does not equate reach with impact

rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently distributes content and interprets response appropriately.
rubrics.applied_standard: Manages authentic release/distribution.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Develops strategy and teaches responsible performance analysis.

rubrics.name: Systems Thinking
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently analyzes a complex system and identifies material dependencies and risks.
rubrics.applied_standard: Analysis influences authentic system or project design.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews architectures and teaches systemic reasoning.

rubrics.name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
strong_qualifying_evidence: CISA-ICS-300 / CISA-ICS-401 or comparable catalog-resolved federal training
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently handles realistic scenarios safely, with all security-critical criteria meeting the independent standard.
rubrics.applied_standard: Participates responsibly in authentic protected systems.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews operational security hygiene and teaches secure practice without exceeding role.

rubrics.name: Spatial Intelligence
strong_qualifying_evidence: NOAA-DIGITAL-COAST-ACADEMY / NASA-ARSET or comparable catalog-resolved training
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently produces a defensible spatial interpretation from authorized data.
rubrics.applied_standard: Spatial intelligence supports authentic research or operations.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews spatial analyses and identifies misleading layers, uncertainty, or unsupported inference.

rubrics.name: Infrastructure & Energy Literacy
strong_qualifying_evidence: DOE-FEMP-TRAINING-CATALOG / EPA-ENERGYSTAR-PM-TRAINING or comparable applied evidence
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently explains an infrastructure system and its major constraints and tradeoffs.
rubrics.applied_standard: Contributes meaningfully to authentic infrastructure analysis.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Guides interdisciplinary analysis while respecting professional-design boundaries.

rubrics.name: Operational Decision Support
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently turns complex information into bounded, actionable decision support.
rubrics.applied_standard: Decision support is used by an authentic responsible decision-maker.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Reviews decision-support products and prevents unsupported certainty or authority substitution.

rubrics.name: Automation & Tooling
rubrics.verified_minimum: Independently builds a bounded reliable automation with reviewability and safeguards.
rubrics.applied_standard: Automation operates in an authentic workflow with monitored outcomes.
rubrics.mentor_standard: Architects or reviews automations and guides others without removing required human authority.
